verdict.rationale: Navan claims 'seamless integrations with most ERPs' and its API exposes accounting preferences, ERP settings config changes, and company-field/option-value management, which implies first-party ERP sync with configurable accounting fields. The evidence never names QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero, and never shows GL, class, or department mapping controls. Missing for 10: named QuickBooks/NetSuite/Xero connectors, documented GL account/class/department mapping that finance controls, details of transaction sync behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
